label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton currently defaults to CSV and uses local component state without persisting the selected format to localStorage. We should update ExportButton to remember the last used export format in localStorage so that it persists across report openings.
